criteria.description: POST /api/favourites with a non-existent productId must return HTTP 404 with JSON body { error, code, requestId } produced by errorHandler, not inline.
criteria.evidence: middleware.test.ts > 'Error propagation > POST /api/favourites with a non-existent productId returns 404' PASSED. favouriteController.add calls next(err), which reaches errorHandler; errorHandler returns { error, code, requestId } (line 25 of errorHandler.ts). criteria.description: favouriteController.add must call next(err) in the ProductNotFoundError catch branch, not res.status(404).json(...).
criteria.evidence: Reading src/benchmark-backend/src/controllers/favouriteController.ts lines 19-25: catch block contains 'if (err instanceof ProductNotFoundError) { next(err); return; }' at line 21. No res.status(404) call anywhere in the add handler.

criteria.description: GET /api/products/compare with valid-format but non-existent ids must return HTTP 400 with { error, code, requestId }.
criteria.evidence: middleware.test.ts > 'Error propagation > GET /api/products/compare with valid format but non-existent ids returns 400' PASSED. compareController calls next(_err) which reaches errorHandler, returning { error, code, requestId }. Test run: 22 passed (22), exit 0.

criteria.description: compareController.compare must call next(_err) (not bare next()) so the error reaches errorHandler.
criteria.evidence: Reading src/benchmark-backend/src/controllers/compareController.ts lines 9-11: catch block is 'catch (_err) { next(_err); }'. The caught error is passed to next, not bare next().

criteria.description: When rate limit exceeded, response must be HTTP 429 with Retry-After header set to seconds until retry.
criteria.evidence: rateLimiter.ts line 28: calls next(new RateLimitError(retryAfter)) where retryAfter = Math.max(1, ...). errorHandler.ts lines 13-17: checks RateLimitError, calls res.setHeader('Retry-After', String(err.retryAfterSeconds)) then res.status(err.statusCode). All 22 tests pass (exit 0).

criteria.description: rateLimiter must import and use RateLimitError from ../errors, not bare new Error(...).
criteria.evidence: Reading src/benchmark-backend/src/middleware/rateLimiter.ts line 2: 'import { RateLimitError } from "../errors"'. Line 28: 'next(new RateLimitError(retryAfter))'. No bare new Error(...) passed to next for the rate-limit case.
